title: Warranty Coverage Trip Charge on Technician Visits — Billing Desk Card
content:
Warranty Coverage prices the trip charge for a completed technician visit on a warranty claim that the warranty terms bill a trip for, which is a visit outside the labor term or a visit at which the technician found no covered defect, and books it on the warranty charges of the registration, dated with the date of the visit and tied to the claim the visit served. The charge is the trip charge alone: the labor billed on such a visit is not priced by it, and a visit inside the labor term at which a covered defect is repaired still carries no trip charge. A trip charge that works out to zero books nothing and owes no trip charge entry.

## When the trip charge is fixed

The trip charge of a visit that rebooks a chargeable missed visit on the same claim is fixed only after the records carry the no-show fee entry owed for that missed visit, a missed visit whose fee works out to zero owing none.

Put the other way round: while the records do not yet carry the no-show fee entry owed for the chargeable missed visit on the same claim that a visit rebooks, the trip charge of that visit is not yet fixed; a missed visit whose fee works out to zero owes no such entry.

## What the billing tool does

`bill_visit_trip_5cd049ac` bills the trip charge for one completed technician visit on a warranty claim. One call adds one trip charge entry to the warranty charges of the registration, dated with the date of the visit, tied to the claim the visit served and carrying the claim's component. The amount owed by the registered owner rises by exactly that charge. Nothing else on the registration or the claim changes; the owner can see the new trip charge on the warranty charges of the registration.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `bill_visit_trip_5cd049ac` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_registration_id` | the registration the visit was made under, as returned by the warranty registration lookup | identifier |
| `warranty_claim_id` | the warranty claim the visit served, as returned by the warranty claim lookup or shown on the visit in the warranty activity lookup | identifier |
| `visit_date` | the date of the technician visit exactly as shown on that visit in the warranty activity lookup; it becomes the date of the trip charge | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | the trip charge owed for that visit | USD, a positive amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A receipt with `warranty_activity_id` (the reference of the new trip charge entry), `warranty_registration_id` (the registration billed), `warranty_claim_id` (the claim the charge belongs to), `charge_kind` (always `trip_charge`), `activity_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the charge carries) and `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the charge booked). A receipt carrying a `warranty_activity_id` means the trip charge is now on the registration's warranty charges.
